caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with a curved, hinged lid that is partially open. The chest is composed of light brown wood planks, visible by the grain and knot patterns, and is reinforced at the edges with darker brown metal bands fastened by round-headed rivets. The inner area of the chest appears to be empty and shaded in a darker color, giving the appearance of depth. There is a gold or brass-colored lock plate on the front middle section of the chest, although no visible lock is attached. The chest is centered on an off-white or beige background without any other objects or details present in the drawing.
